info.title: Tripadvisor API
info.description:
Trip-planning data from Tripadvisor: geo search plus attractions, restaurants and hotels by location (geo_id), with ratings, reviews, price and coordinates. Resolve a place name with /search, then list with /attractions, /restaurants, /hotels.

Every request needs an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys. A successful request uses one credit, unless its operation says more (`x-credits`). That price covers 200 rows (or the operation's `x-credits-rows`); a request that returns more pays it again for each further page of that many rows. The `x-maviapi-credits` response header says what a request cost.

Endpoint reference with live examples: https://maviapi.com/apis/tripadvisor

get.description:
Top attractions / things to do for a location (geo_id).

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 30 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items returned from the page

description.example: Completed in 1889, this colossal landmark is now a famous symbol of French civic pride.

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

get.description:
Attractions for a location (geo_id), 30 per page with working pagination, an optional category filter, categories and tags as id/name arrays and a description when available.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 30 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based source page, 30 attractions each (page N returns ranks 30*(N-1)+1 to 30*N)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional attraction category id: 47 Sights & Landmarks, 49 Museums, 57 Nature & Parks, 56 Fun & Games, 20 Nightlife, 40 Spas & Wellness, 41 Classes & Workshops, 48 Zoos & Aquariums, 52 Water & Amusement Parks, 53 Casinos & Gambling, 55 Boat Tours & Water Sports. The ids the geo offers are listed in data.available_categories.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items returned from the page

category.description: The applied category filter, or null

total.description: Attractions the site holds for this geo (and category); null past the last page

category.description: The site's joined type string (same as /attractions)

description.example: One of the smaller mosques in the city, it was built by Rustem Pasa in 1561 and is noted for the very fine tiles covering the interior and exterior walls.

categories.description: Top-level attraction categories (the filter applied first, then those derived from the tags)

tags.description: The attraction's type tags, the parts of `category` with their ids

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

get.description:
Trip planner in one call: a place name (or geo_id) is resolved to its location, then its attractions, hotels or restaurants (kind) are listed 30 per page, optionally with the first page of reviews for the top N results. Ambiguous names answer 400 with the candidates.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 30 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place name (city, region or country), qualified with its region or country when several places share the name ("Paris, France", "Paris, Texas"), or a numeric geo_id. Case and accents are ignored. An ambiguous or unknown name answers 400 with the candidate places.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: What to list for the place

parameters.name: reviews
parameters.description: Attach the first page of reviews (15) to the top N results of the page; 0 for none. A review lookup that fails leaves that result's reviews null.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page of 30 results (page N holds ranks 30*(N-1)+1 to 30*N); up to 333 for restaurants, 1000 otherwise

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items returned from the page

total.description: Results the site holds for the place and kind (the site caps restaurants and attractions at 10000)

items.description: The rows of /attractions-v2, /hotels or /restaurants-v2 (all their fields) plus type and geo_id

reviews.description: Only on the top `reviews` results: their first 15 reviews (null when that lookup failed)

text.example: Booked the summit tickets in advance and skipped the queue.

get.description:
Live date-driven hotel price offers for a location (geo_id).

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 30 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

get.description:
Live, dated hotel offers for a location (geo_id), paged through every hotel the site lists: offset reaches data.total (the site's own hotel count), limit up to 100. Optional currency and sort.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 100 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: TripAdvisor geo_id from /search (e.g. 187147 Paris, 60763 New York City)

parameters.name: checkInDate
parameters.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later). Default: 30 days from today

parameters.name: checkOutDate
parameters.description: Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD, after checkInDate). Default: checkInDate + 2 nights

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency the offers are priced in (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, TRY)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the list: POPULARITY (traveler ranked), BEST_VALUE, PRICE_LOW_TO_HIGH or DISTANCE (to the city center)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Hotels to skip; walk it up to pagination.total to reach every hotel of the location

offers_complete.description: True when the site had finished collecting partner offers for this page

total.description: The site's own count of hotels for the location

rank.description: Position in the sorted list (offset + index + 1)

lowest_offer.description: Lowest offer for the whole stay, formatted in the requested currency; null when no partner has availability

auction_winner_offer.description: The featured partner's offer, formatted in the requested currency

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

get.description:
Hotels / accommodation for a location (geo_id), 30 per page.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 30 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items returned from the page

price_range.description: Typical undated USD nightly band for the location

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

total.description: Total hotels in the geo (all pages)

get.description:
ALL hotels under a location (geo_id) in one call, up to ?limit (100/250/1000).

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 250 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many hotels to return, e.g. 100 / 250 / 1000 (max 1000). The full set (up to 1000) is fetched and cached per geo; ?limit slices it.

total.description: Total hotels in the geo (may exceed the 1000 fetch cap)

hotels.description: Same hotel shape as /hotels (rank, id, name, url, rating, review_count, price_range, price_min/max, ranking_position, ranking_string, accommodation_type, phone, address, coordinates, neighborhood, amenities, award, image)

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

get.description:
Photo gallery of one place (hotel/restaurant/attraction) by detail id, with the total photo count.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 100 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TripAdvisor detail id of a hotel, restaurant or attraction (the id the list endpoints return, the d<id> in a place URL)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Photo offset within the gallery's first 100 photos

total.description: Total photos the place has on TripAdvisor (null when unavailable)

caption.example: Would you like to delve into the depths of history? The Basilica Cistern was built in the 6th century...

source.description: Who supplied the photo: TRAVELER, OWNER, MANAGEMENT, ...

total.description: Photos in the fetched window (up to 100)

get.description:
The full photo gallery of one place (hotel/restaurant/attraction) by detail id, with the total photo count: offset reaches the total, limit up to the site's own per-call maximum (100).

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 100 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TripAdvisor detail id of a hotel, restaurant or attraction (the id the list endpoints return, the d<id> in a place URL)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Photos per call, up to the site's own per-call maximum (100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Photo offset within the whole gallery; valid up to data.total

total.description: Total photos the place has on TripAdvisor (null when unavailable); offset reaches it

source.description: Who supplied the photo: TRAVELER, OWNER, MANAGEMENT, ...

get.description: Full detail for one TripAdvisor place (hotel/restaurant/attraction) by detail id: name, rating, review count, ranking, address, coordinates, phone, price level, description, photo count, image, plus amenities (hotels), cuisines (restaurants), opening hours and category. Works for any place id, inside or outside its geo's lists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TripAdvisor detail id (the `id` field from a list endpoint)

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: TripAdvisor geo_id the place belongs to (the `geo_id` of a list row). Used to find the place's list row for ranking and amenities; a place outside that list is still answered.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Place type: hotel, restaurant or attraction

description.example: Book Hotel Europe Saint Severin, Paris on Tripadvisor...

source.description: Which branch served the place: `list` (its geo's list row, which adds ranking and amenities, filled out by the per-place detail) or `detail` (the per-place detail alone, for an id outside the list)

get.description:
Restaurants / eateries for a location (geo_id).

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 30 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items returned from the page

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

get.description:
Restaurants for a location (geo_id), 30 per page with working pagination, optional cuisine and price range filters, and weekly opening hours when available.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 30 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page, 30 restaurants each (page N returns ranks 30*(N-1)+1 to 30*N, the next 30 distinct restaurants)

parameters.name: cuisine
parameters.description: Optional cuisine filter: a cuisine name or id (e.g. Seafood or 10643, Turkish or 10663, Italian or 4617); comma-separate several to match any of them. The cuisines a geo offers are listed in data.available_cuisines.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Optional price range filter: cheap (Cheap Eats, $), mid (Mid-range, $ - $$) or fine (Fine Dining, $$); comma-separate several (e.g. cheap,mid).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items returned from the page

filters.description: The applied filters (empty arrays when none)

total.description: Restaurants the site holds for this geo and filters (the site caps the unfiltered count at 10000)

street.example: Kucuk Ayasofya Mah. Cayiroglu Sok. No: 32/B Kucuk Ayasofya Mah., Istanbul 34122 Türkiye

opening_hours.description: Weekly schedule in local time (HH:MM); several intervals a day when the place closes in between, an empty day = closed; null when the site has no hours

geo_id.description: The geo_id this list was asked for (the `geo` param), ready for /place

get.description:
Traveler reviews for one place by detail id.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 15 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TripAdvisor detail id (from a list endpoint)

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: Ignored: accepted for compatibility with the other detail endpoints; reviews are looked up by id alone

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Ignored: accepted for compatibility with the other detail endpoints; reviews are looked up by id alone

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page; ~18 reviews on page 1, deeper pages best-effort (10 each)

text.example: We stayed here for three nights after arriving in Paris...

owner_response.example: Dear Guest, Thank you very much for taking the time...

get.description:
Geo search: resolve a place name to TripAdvisor locations (geo_id + coordinates).

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 10 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place name to resolve, e.g. a city or country

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Ignored: accepted so older calls stay valid; results are not filtered by type. Use /search-v3?types= to filter

get.description:
Geo search v2: resolve a place name to up to 10 TripAdvisor locations (geo_id + coordinates + thumbnail), optionally biased toward a lat/lng point.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 10 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place or venue name to resolve, e.g. a city, landmark or hotel

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Optional latitude to bias results toward (give together with lng)

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Optional longitude to bias results toward (give together with lat)

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Ignored: accepted so older calls stay valid; results are not filtered by type. Use /search-v3?types= to filter

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results per page (the endpoint returns at most 10 locations)

thumbnail.description: Primary photo, or null when the place has none

url_template.description: Substitute {width}/{height}; the CDN serves standard sizes (200, 300, 400, 600, 1200, 2000 wide; height -1 keeps the aspect ratio)

results.description: Up to 10 locations, nearest-to-the-point first when lat/lng is given

center.description: The lat/lng bias point, or null when none was given

get.description:
Geo search v3: resolve a place name to every TripAdvisor location the site's search returns (geo_id + coordinates + thumbnail), optionally biased toward a lat/lng point and filtered by kind with types; page with limit/offset.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 20 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place or venue name to resolve, e.g. a city, landmark or hotel

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Optional latitude to bias results toward (give together with lng)

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Optional longitude to bias results toward (give together with lat)

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Optional filter by kind of place, a comma list of: geo, accommodation, attraction, attraction_product, eatery, airline, ship, cruise_line (e.g. geo for cities and countries only, eatery,attraction for both). Omit it to get every kind. The filter keeps the ranking of the unfiltered list

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results per page. No cap of its own: any value is accepted, and the list is bounded only by how many locations the site returns for the query (up to about 200). Omit it to get the whole list

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip, to page through the list with limit (the site itself has no paging, so the whole list is fetched once and paged here)

thumbnail.description: Primary photo, or null when the place has none

url_template.description: Substitute {width}/{height}; the CDN serves standard sizes (200, 300, 400, 600, 1200, 2000 wide; height -1 keeps the aspect ratio)

results.description: Every location the site returns for the query, deduplicated: the site's top-ranked rows first (the same rows, in the same order, as /search-v2), then more places of each kind (cities, hotels, attractions, tours, restaurants). Nearest-to-the-point first when lat/lng is given

center.description: The lat/lng bias point, or null when none was given

total.description: All locations the site returned for the query

maviapiKey.description: Your maviapi API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or cannot be used.

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent, or the key is invalid or revoked (`missing_api_key`, `invalid_api_key`).

AccountSuspended.description: The account that owns the key is suspended.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key. Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded for this API key.

UpstreamFailed.description: The source site could not be read this time. Retrying later usually works.

example.message: The upstream source could not be fetched
